title: Run evolution × liminal overlay (Nova adjusted_count) — corrected tags
abstract: Run the overlay builder with Nova’s adjusted_count series and write adjusted variant panel/summary. Corrected tags (no underscores).

original_submission.content:
import json, shutil, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

OVERLAYS = Path('storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/overlays')
OVERLAYS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

NOVA_ADJ = 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/nova/liminal/id_1505/liminal_timeseries_adjusted.csv'
BUILDER = 'storage/shared/atlas/analysis/meta_edge_evolution/build_evolution_liminal_overlay.py'

BASE_PANEL = OVERLAYS / 'evolution_liminal_overlay.png'
BASE_SUM = OVERLAYS / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_summary.txt'
ADJ_PANEL = OVERLAYS / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_adjusted.png'
ADJ_SUM = OVERLAYS / 'evolution_liminal_overlay_adjusted_summary.txt'

# Run builder with adjusted_count column
cmd = ['python', BUILDER, '--nova_csv', NOVA_ADJ, '--nova_column', 'adjusted_count']
cp = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)

# Parse builder stdout (best-effort)
out = {}
try:
    for line in (cp.stdout or '').splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith('{') and line.endswith('}'):
            out = json.loads(line)
except Exception:
    pass

# Copy baseline-named outputs to adjusted variants for clarity
if BASE_PANEL.exists():
    shutil.copyfile(BASE_PANEL, ADJ_PANEL)
if BASE_SUM.exists():
    txt = BASE_SUM.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    new = []
    seen_panel = False
    seen_nova_col = False
    for ln in txt:
        if ln.startswith('panel='):
            new.append(f'panel={ADJ_PANEL}')
            new.append('variant=adjusted_count')
            seen_panel = True
        elif ln.startswith('nova_column='):
            new.append('nova_column=adjusted_count')
            seen_nova_col = True
        else:
            new.append(ln)
    if not seen_panel:
        new.append(f'panel={ADJ_PANEL}')
    if not seen_nova_col:
        new.append('nova_column=adjusted_count')
    ADJ_SUM.write_text('\n'.join(new) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')

print(json.dumps({
    "adjusted_csv": NOVA_ADJ,
    "adjusted_panel": str(ADJ_PANEL),
    "adjusted_summary": str(ADJ_SUM),
    "builder_stdout_tail": (cp.stdout or "")[-600:],
    "builder_stderr_tail": (cp.stderr or "")[-600:]
}))
